description: Reference PHP → .NET 8 / C# 12 scaffold for an Acme storefront cart/pricing slice, from a signed php spec (targetStack=dotnet8). The .NET option of a dual-target pair — java-spring/canonical-php-catalog-service is the Java projection of the same signed spec, and the SME picks the target per routine. Demonstrates the same PHP→static-type idiom gap: loose == juggling ("0" == false) ⟶ explicit typed comparison; the PHP array-as-ordered-map ⟶ a CartLine record + Dictionary; isset/empty/?? ⟶ nullable + explicit checks WITHOUT the empty("0") bug; the $_SESSION superglobal ⟶ an injected ISessionCart; money-as-float ⟶ decimal (AwayFromZero, 2dp); and @-suppressed silent failures ⟶ explicit typed exceptions. Built as a console Exe so the csharp-sidecar's /compile-and-run EXECUTES the Program.cs acceptance harness — genuine compile + run verification (the sidecar has no xUnit runner). Dependency-free, so dotnet publish needs no NuGet beyond the base SDK.

matches.fallback: Used for php routines in a cart/pricing/checkout slice when the SME picks the .NET target.

verification.sourceExecutionEquivalenceReason: PHP has a free/OSS runtime, so source-execution equivalence is FEASIBLE via a php-sidecar — that sidecar is not built yet, so equivalence is NOT claimed here.
